messages:
rachel: Originating RC rc-2026-03-22-D (sha: ffe12b9). Change window today 20:00-21:00 UTC. Need signoffs: keystore rotation, KV prod-shadow bake, smoke tests, and release notes. Will pin before promo. @kyle please run KV bake on prod-shadow and report any transient errors. @nina please kick off smoke suite.

kyle: KV bake started on prod-shadow. warmed=44 shards, hit_rate=0.93, mem=70%. Observed one transient 502 during initial connections, retried automatically. Snippet:
```
2026-03-22T18:41:10Z kv-warm: shards=44 hit_rate=0.93 transient_502=1 mem=70%
```
Extended warm +5m to stabilize. No OOMs.

nina: Smoke suite triggered. Criteria: error_rate <= baseline +0.5% abs; token diffs on 150 examples <=2 fail; latency p95 <= 1.2x baseline. Automated run: token_ok=149/150, error_delta +0.03%, p95 +7%  all green. Flagged one long-context truncation sample for manual review.

rachel: Keystore rotation completed to kms-main-05, secret v7 in vault, decryption probe passed. Pinning now.

deploy-bot: Action: `/pin rc-2026-03-22-D` requested by rachel.

deploy-bot: Pin applied  pin_id=pin-11337, artifact=ffe12b9, pinned_by=rachel at 3861112250

rachel: Starting canary: `/promote rc-2026-03-22-D --to canary --percent 7 --duration 15m --pin`

deploy-bot: Canary job queued. job=job-11338. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/11338/logs

ops-oncall: Watching canary. Thresholds set: errors +0.5% abs, latency p95 +25%. Traces enabled.

(15m later)

ops-oncall: Canary complete. Metrics: error_delta +0.02%, token_ok 149/150, p95 +6%. Recommend staged promote 20->60->100 with a 5m guard after stage2.

rachel: Initiating staged promote now but calling out upstream proxy team to monitor—observed occasional 429 bursts last week. If we see upstream 429 spike at stage2, hold before final stage.

rachel: `/promote rc-2026-03-22-D --to prod --staged --stages 20,60,100 --pin`

deploy-bot: Promotion started. job=job-11339. Stage 1 -> 20% applied at 3861112268.

deploy-bot: Stage 2 -> 60% applied at 3861112276.

ops-oncall: Observability: small surge of upstream 429s in us-central at stage2 (rate 0.9% above baseline). Not yet breaching alert but recommend hold and notify upstream. Holding before final stage.

kyle: Notified upstream; they will deploy a backoff tweak in ~4m. We should wait.

(4m later)

ops-oncall: Upstream backoff tweak deployed. Telemetry returned to baseline. Proceeding to final stage.

deploy-bot: Stage 3 -> 100% applied at 3861112283. Promotion complete. rc-2026-03-22-D now live in prod. :tada:

rachel: Post-promote: running 30m post-checks. No alerts in the first 10m. Rollback playbook in release doc if needed:
```
# quick revert to previous stable RC
/promote rc-2026.02.20-122 --to prod --pin --force
# kubernetes fallback
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-service --to-revision=2244
# emergency feature-gate circuit-break
curl -X POST https://feature-gate.prod/flags/llm-service -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

nina: I'll update release notes with canary summary and ticket links. Closing thread after post-check window clears.
